leadText: Kai (Japanese: ダイ Dai) is a minor character who appeared in The Rise of Darkrai.
plainText:
Kai (Japanese: ダイ Dai) is a minor character who appeared in The Rise of Darkrai.

==In the movies==
 
Kai, along with Maury and Allegra, challenged and to a ; specifically, he went up against and her , which began as a puff-contest (befitting their species' nature).

Kai was later invited by Baron Alberto to help fight off .

During the ending credits, he was seen participating in the Alamos Town Pokémon Contest, where he defeated Maury in the Battle Stage. He was likely defeated by Allegra in the finals, since he was onstage with her when she received the Ribbon.

==In the manga==
===Movie adaptations===
 
Kai appears in the manga adaptation of . Here, he is a veteran Trainer drafted by Baron Alberto to defeat Darkrai. However, despite battling alongside Allegra and Maury, the three are no match for the powerful Pokémon.

====Pokémon====
 
 

==Trivia==
Kai, Maury, and Allegra each own the final form of one Sinnoh first partner Pokémon.
Though he was not referred to by name in the dub, Pokémon.com has since revealed that his name is Kai.
Kai's character design resembles that of Empoleon's color scheme.
